parsed.note_claim: Princes Street Gardens closed due to the weather.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: As a precaution, the City of Edinburgh Council has decided to close Princes Street Gardens, Lauriston Castle Grounds, and Saughton Winter Gardens to the public.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly confirms the closure of Princes Street Gardens due to strong winds and Met Office warnings, substantiating the note's claim.
